summary.text: Mike Baker is the Democratic candidate for Ohio House of Representatives District 52 in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against Republican Cliff Winkel.
Baker owns First Choice Photography and, in a Ballotpedia survey, described himself as a small business owner, father and lifelong Ohioan.

paragraphs.text: Michael Baker was born in Elyria, Ohio.
He earned a high school diploma from Midview High School and an associate degree from ITT Technical Institute in 2006.

Baker said in the survey that his work building businesses in Elyria and Lorain County has shown him the challenges families face, from underfunded schools to an economy that leaves working people behind.
Baker defeated Graig Bansek in the May 5, 2026 Democratic primary for District 52, 50.8 percent to 49.2 percent.

In the Ballotpedia survey, he listed three campaign messages: accountable, responsive leadership; strong public schools and support for working families; and transparent government with fair economic policy.
